This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 7-14. TYPICAL CARGO RACK INSTALLATION NO. 3".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a line drawing of a typical cargo rack installation, viewed from an angle above and to one side. It depicts a rectangular metal frame supported by tubular rails and brackets, with cross-members and attachment points visible.
